fields.name: SequenceLengthening
fields.description: SequenceLengthening is the finite public selection shape for a retry-backoff lengthening mode.

members.name: value
members.description: The selected retry-backoff mode: Linear = 0, Lengthening = 1 (the default; 1, 3, 5, 7… × interval), HalfSquare = 2, Squaring = 3. The only other declared name is the [Obsolete] alias Fibonacci = Lengthening, which shares value 1 and so is not a distinct mode; configuration value "Fibonacci" binds to Lengthening.

representations.C#: public enum SequenceLengthening { Linear = 0, Lengthening = 1, HalfSquare = 2, Squaring = 3, [Obsolete("Use Lengthening.")] Fibonacci = Lengthening }
